policy: Content-first annual revision. The stage UI remains unchanged.

grade6Rule: Never display an empty-units fallback when source-derived units exist.
qualityRules: Every published lesson must expose vocabulary, grammar, examples and practice.
Practice answers are value-based and must remain correct after option shuffling.
Diagnostic and final-readiness item IDs must not overlap.
Final-readiness must have an explicit threshold.
Missing source material is reported; content is never invented as a substitute.
